This session is INBOUND FEEDBACK from another project: Bilko-Game-Academy (/home/bilko/Projects/Bilko-Game-Academy, session tell-me-a-summary-of-this-project-and-run-it-loc-9d48a074). It was raised while working on: Tell me a summary of this project and run it local to see it  What type of games can this project host?  Where is it hosted?  How does it handle persistence?   Overview of the project. Nobody in this project wrote the report below — an agent working in that project did, and it may be wrong about this codebase. Verify the claim against the code here before acting on it, and if it does not hold, say so and close the session rather than building against it.

Goal: Raise game-academy publish budget to 5 MB gz (alpha relaunch with 3-4 MB WebP sprites)

## Why
The owner wants Bilko Game Academy back live at bilko.run/projects/game-academy/ as an alpha whose key feature is bilko.run sign-in with cloud progress for returning users. It was unpublished (89e0a80) for 116 MB of uncached PNG sprites. Game Academy is converting sprites to downscaled WebP (~3-4 MB total, browser-cached CacheFirst by its service worker) and removing sourcemaps (~0.4 MB gz code incl. Phaser). The publish budget gate (default 200 KB) will block that publish without an explicit per-app budget.

## Proposed plan
1. Add APP_BUDGETS_GZ_BYTES['game-academy'] = 5_000_000 in mcp-host-server/src/contract/app-budgets.ts with a one-line comment (Phaser game + ~117 WebP sprites, post-incident; sprites were 116 MB PNG).
2. Align the server/db.ts seed for game-academy (currently 200 KB) if it is read anywhere for enforcement.
3. Optional: long-lived Cache-Control for /projects/game-academy/boat-shooter-sprites/*.webp to keep egress low on repeat visits.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] publish_static_project for slug game-academy passes the budget gate for a bundle up to 5,000,000 bytes gz
- [ ] Other apps' budgets unchanged

## Details
Evidence: Game-Academy dist measured 2026-10-17: code 533 KB gz with sourcemaps (sourcemaps now being removed); sample of 10 sprites converted 1024->512 px WebP averaged ~10-25 KB each, so 117 sprites ~= 2-3 MB. Game-Academy's publish PRD (13-publish-alpha) will stop with NEEDS_HUMAN rather than bypass the budget gate if this is not raised. The redirect-loop bug on missing static bundles was filed separately.

Reference: /home/bilko/Projects/Bilko/mcp-host-server/src/contract/app-budgets.ts

I checked the report against the code here and it was right: `game-academy` had no budget entry of its own, so the publish gate held it to the 200 KB default. I raised it to 5 MB gz and pushed the change to `origin/main` as `584e19b`.

- **Plan step 1 (budget):** added `'game-academy': 5_000_000` with a one-line comment in `mcp-host-server/src/contract/app-budgets.ts`. I rebuilt `mcp-host-server/dist/` and committed it with the source. No other app's budget changed. The sanity and dist-sync tests and `pnpm typecheck` pass.
- **Plan step 2 (`server/db.ts`):** no change needed. The gate doesn't read the database. At boot, `server/db.ts` copies every entry in the budget file into the database and only ever raises a value, so the 200 KB row for `game-academy` becomes 5 MB on the next deploy.
- **Bonus:** apps with their own budget entry also skip the publish gate's file-count check, so ~117 sprite files won't be blocked by it.
- **Plan step 3 (cache headers):** skipped on purpose. `server/static-cache.ts` already caches `.webp` files for a day, and repeat visits after that cost only a cheap revalidation. The sprite filenames don't change when the image does, so caching them for a year would leave visitors with old sprites after a re-publish. The game's own service worker already keeps them in the browser.
- **Local branch state:** I pushed through a temporary worktree because the shared tree has other sessions' uncommitted files, and a hook blocks stash and reset there. So local `main` still has the same change under a different commit, `d161d3c`, and hasn't merged `origin/main` yet. The next `git pull --rebase` will drop that duplicate commit automatically.
- **Using it:** the local `bilko-host` MCP runs from `dist/`, so it may need a restart before `publish_static_project` sees the new 5 MB budget.
